column1: # GeckoLib 5 moved the whole library from software.bernie.geckolib to com.geckolib and
# reorganised it at the same time, so a mod built against 4.x dies on its first touch with
# Derived from the geckolib-forge-1.20.1-4.8.4 and geckolib-neoforge-26.1.2-5.5.2 jars. A pair
# is taken when the plain package swap lands on a class 5.5.2 ships, or when exactly one class
# in 5.5.2 carries that simple name. Nothing ambiguous was found, and 91 further 4.x classes
# have no counterpart at all: those are internals such as the texture cache, and a mod that
# reaches them needs a real port rather than a rename.
# GeckoLib 4.x tops out at Minecraft 1.21.4 and 5.x starts at 1.21.5, so the shim that reads
# this table is gated on the host being 1.21.5 or newer. Applying it on an older host would
# rewrite a mod onto packages that host's GeckoLib does not have.
